summary_1line: Sisupala angrily insults Bhishma and Krishna at the Rajasuya assembly, mocking Krishna’s feats and accusing Bhishma of hypocrisy and false morality.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal assembly, Sisupala stands raging and pointing accusingly at the aged Bhishma seated calmly among gathered kings.
Sisupala mockingly gestures toward Krishna in the crowded court while monarchs watch in tense silence.
An old swan on the seashore secretly devours the eggs entrusted to him by other trusting birds.
